messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: us-central1 GPU pool degraded — multiple node reboots and upstream BGP flap reported. Affected capacity ~40% for managed-gpu-pool-A. Start 09:18Z.

oncall-ops: seeing failed kubelet heartbeats on nodes gpu-a-1..4, also some ENI detach errors. Re-routing in progress.

alex_m: initiating immediate traffic shift: will move in-flight prod routes to us-west2 reserved pool. Doing a controlled weight change (50% -> 100%) over 10m.

rita_l: can we avoid evicting too many pods? cold-start latency for some models spikes when rescheduling. Suggest we prefer cross-region routing to Dedicated pools first.

sam_platform: FYI autoscaler for gpu-pool-A was set to max 80 nodes; it's hitting soft limits due to quota bump delay. Opened ticket with cloud quota team.

marie_p: quick mitigation checklist: 1) throttle long-running eval jobs, 2) disable non-critical batch retries, 3) pre-warm us-west2 warm-pool. Who's owning each?

oncall-ops: I will throttle evals and stop retries now. Doing: `/ops throttle evals --scope=us-central1 --percent=60`.

rita_l: pre-warm command executed: ```infractl warm-pool create --region=us-west2 --type=gpu --count=12 --labels=hot-swap``` pre-warm accepted, ETA 6m.

alex_m: traffic-shift staged: envoy weight change applied to route inference.v1: `traffic_weights: us-central1:0 -> us-west2:100` (gradual ramp to avoid thundering herd). Watching `gpu_pool_utilization` and `5xx_rate`.

cost-ops: heads up — relying on cross-region Dedicated pools will increase egress and reserved capacity cost. Estimate +18% for the day if we sustain full reroute. Approve? :eyes:

marie_p: approve for now, prefer reliability over cost for partial day. Please document in post-incident notes with exact meter readings.

sam_platform: observed BGP route flaps from provider X; likely upstream maintenance + a misapplied route-map. Network team engaged. Temporary fix: pinned control-plane egress to alternate peering.

oncall-ops: manual reroute complete, traffic at 100% us-west2. Some models saw +120ms median latency for first requests (cold start). Reduced after pre-warm.

rita_l: action item: add a canary setting in the routing layer to test cross-region failover for at least three minutes before full shift. Current playbook does immediate shift which causes burst.

alex_m: agreed — suggested change in runbook: add step "gradual canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m" and add automatic rollback if `p95_latency` increases >250ms or `5xx_rate` >1% for 5m.

marie_p: another runbook gap: autoscaler soft-quotas. We need an automated quota-check preflight that runs hourly if pool utilization >70%. Add as checklist item.

sam_platform: proposed autoscaler tweak snippet to add to runbook: ```yaml
# autoscaler overrides
scale_up_cooldown: 90s
scale_down_cooldown: 300s
max_nodes_soft: 120 # safety buffer
quota_preflight: true
```

cost-ops: post-incident cost items: 1) bill reconciliation for cross-region egress, 2) chargeback to product team if reserved capacity used >4h.

oncall-ops: creating post-incident doc now. Draft notes will include timeline, mitigation commands, telemetry graphs, and ownership for action items.

rita_l: suggested long-term fixes (open items): - automate warm-pool pre-warm during provider maintenance windows, - add BGP flap detector to infra-alerts, - stage cross-region synthetic tests to run every 10m.

alex_m: I'll own the BGP flap detector (owner: alex_m) ETA EOW.

marie_p: I'll own the runbook edits (owner: marie_p) ETA 3 business days. Will add the canary step and autoscaler preflight.

sam_platform: I'll follow up on quota automation and warm-pool orchestration (owner: sam_platform) ETA 2 business days.

cost-ops: I will produce a preliminary cost impact summary by EOD (owner: cost-ops).

oncall-ops: Postmortem checklist created, assigned action items in the doc. Scheduling a 30m incident review at 16:00Z.

sre-bot: NOTE: alert resolved — us-central1 GPU capacity recovered to >95% after upstream fix at 10:40Z. Marking incident state: mitigated.

marie_p: closing notes: runbook changes +canary +quota-preflight +bgp-detector, owners assigned. We'll reconvene after cost report to decide on paid reserved burst vs. keeping warm pools. :heavy_check_mark:
_meta: generated by dataset-gen: incident thread covering runbook updates, reroute and post-incident action items
